name: step-counter
description: A hybrid JavaScript (Node.js ES Modules) and C application demonstrating cross-language Foreign Function Interface (FFI) integration. JavaScript handles input sanitization, schema validation, and functional goal filtering via a lexical closure factory (createGoalFilter), while a compiled C dynamic-link library (tracker.dll) traverses contiguous step arrays using pointer arithmetic to compute the cumulative step count for successful days.
author: Harry Eliki
